checks.explanation: Physical observations must differ and have a useful declared time separation.
This initial screen requires identical release and pipeline version.
Scientific screening requires full CWAVE/CBAND calibration data.
Source and calibration archive URLs and verified file identities are required.
Unknown active flag bits must be investigated.
Coordinate arithmetic check; this does not measure absolute alignment.
Both observations need common unflagged and calibrated support.
Engineering screening threshold across all common supported pixels; not equivalence of spectral response functions.
Registration residuals, local image response, calibration association, and independent scientific review remain required.

limitations: Engineering feasibility screen only. No validated motion, photometry, or discovery.
Thresholds are provisional engineering choices, not NASA standards.
WCS reprojection does not establish reference-source alignment.

registration.method: Gaia DR3 anchored, native-image integrated-Gaussian centroids; no fitted registration transform
limitations: Reference identity is independent of SPHEREx image processing. No astrometric correction was fitted.
Empirical Gaussian profiles are diagnostics, not an ePSF astrometric likelihood.
No formal positional uncertainties or absolute astrometric precision are claimed.
Catalogue positions use proper motion; sub-5 mas parallax is neglected for this arcsecond-scale check.
References outside the inspection region can constrain surrounding registration, but do not prove local distortions are absent.

survey_timeline.alignment: Common requested ICRS grid; registration is not assumed verified.
survey_timeline.display_policy: Shared sequence limits; wavelength-dependent differences must not be interpreted as variability.
survey_timeline.reason: Genuine observations on the same requested ICRS grid. Dates and wavelengths can differ; brightness or positional differences are visual evidence only, with no physical-change claim.

matched_wavelength.comparison_scope: Qualitative matched-wavelength inspection; no established physical change.
matched_wavelength.alignment: Independent stationary-reference checks passed for every included pair.
matched_wavelength.display_policy: Shared sequence limits; no PSF matching or calibrated photometry.
matched_wavelength.reason: Every pair in this subset passes the unchanged wavelength, support and stationary-reference checks; qualitative inspection only, with scientific review pending.

reference_catalogue.query: SELECT TOP 2000 source_id,ra,dec,ref_epoch,pmra,pmdec,parallax,ruwe,phot_g_mean_mag FROM gaia_dr3_source WHERE CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',210.80227,54.34895,0.23))=1 AND phot_g_mean_mag<20 AND ruwe<1.4 AND pmra IS NOT NULL AND pmdec IS NOT NULL

interpretation: No measured motion or calibrated variability is established.
selection_strategy: Verified original cache when applicable; otherwise bounded metadata/header wavelength preselection, followed by unchanged scientific checks.

Gaia DR3: https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243940. ESA Gaia data processed by DPAC.
